blocks.zh: USP ⟨1229.7⟩ 氣體滅菌 — 雙語教學版
blocks.en: USP ⟨1229.7⟩ Gaseous Sterilization — Bilingual Teaching Edition

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter

blocks.zh: 理解氣體滅菌（Gaseous Sterilization）的基本原理：利用滅菌氣體的化學反應殺死微生物，適用於不耐熱或不耐輻照的物品
blocks.en: Understand the basic principle of gaseous sterilization: a sterilizing gas kills microorganisms through chemical reaction, which suits items that cannot tolerate heat or irradiation

blocks.zh: 掌握環氧乙烷（Ethylene Oxide, EO）滅菌製程的完整流程：預增濕、抽真空、再增濕、氣體暴露、排氣、曝氣
blocks.en: Master the complete ethylene oxide (EO) sterilization process: prehumidification, air removal (vacuum), rehumidification, gas exposure, gas removal and aeration

blocks.zh: 認識其他滅菌氣體 — 臭氧（Ozone）、二氧化氯（Chlorine Dioxide）、二氧化氮（Nitrogen Dioxide）— 的特性與適用性
blocks.en: Know the characteristics and suitability of the other sterilizing gases: ozone, chlorine dioxide and nitrogen dioxide

blocks.zh: 了解半週期法（Half-Cycle Method）與包圍法（Bracketing Method）兩種驗證策略的差異與應用
blocks.en: Understand the differences between the two validation strategies, the half-cycle method and the bracketing method, and where each applies

blocks.zh: 掌握氣體滅菌驗證的四大要素：設備確效、空腔參數分布、組件/負載佈局、微生物挑戰
blocks.en: Master the four key elements of gaseous sterilization validation: equipment qualification, empty chamber parameter distribution, component/load mapping and microbiological challenge

blocks.zh: 理解 EO 殘留物（EO、ECH、EG）控制的法規要求及其對 CDMO 元件滅菌的實務意義
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory requirements for controlling EO residuals (EO, ECH, EG) and what they mean in practice for component sterilization at a CDMO

blocks.zh: Introduction — 概論
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: Original Text 原文內容
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Gaseous Sterilization（氣體滅菌）：利用具有殺微生物活性的氣體分子，透過化學反應（主要是烷基化作用或氧化作用）殺死微生物。與蒸氣滅菌（利用熱能）和輻照滅菌（利用輻射能量）的殺菌機制根本不同。
blocks.en: Gaseous Sterilization: Uses gas molecules with microbicidal activity to kill microorganisms through chemical reaction (mainly alkylation or oxidation). The killing mechanism is fundamentally different from steam sterilization (which uses thermal energy) and radiation sterilization (which uses radiant energy).

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：
blocks.en: Scope of application:

blocks.zh: 不耐熱的高分子材料 — 塑膠管路、矽膠墊片、一次性充填組件
blocks.en: Heat-sensitive polymeric materials — plastic tubing, silicone gaskets, single-use filling components

blocks.zh: 醫療器材的最終包裝滅菌 — EO 可穿透包裝材料，達成 Terminal Sterilization
blocks.en: Terminal sterilization of medical devices in final packaging — EO can penetrate packaging materials, achieving terminal sterilization

blocks.zh: 非耐壓設備 — 不適合高壓蒸氣滅菌的製程設備
blocks.en: Non-pressure-rated equipment — process equipment that is not suitable for autoclaving

blocks.zh: 不適用：乾粉（氣體無法穿透固體）、含液體物品（氣體在液體中擴散不均）
blocks.en: Not suitable for: dry powders (gas cannot penetrate solids) and liquid-containing items (gas diffuses unevenly in liquids)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Gas vs Vapor
blocks.en: Key Point: Gas vs Vapor

blocks.zh: 氣體（Gas）vs 蒸氣（Vapor）的區別：本章明確排除了在操作溫度下可能以液態和氣態共存的系統（如 H2O2、過乙酸、多聚甲醛）。這些屬於蒸氣滅菌，另見 ⟨1229.11⟩。判斷標準是：如果滅菌劑在操作過程中可能發生凝結（Condensation），就屬於蒸氣製程而非氣體製程。
blocks.en: Gas vs vapor: This chapter explicitly excludes systems in which the agent may exist in both liquid and gaseous states at operating temperatures (such as H2O2, peracetic acid and paraformaldehyde). These are vapor sterilization processes, covered in ⟨1229.11⟩. The test is this: if the sterilant can condense during the process, it is a vapor process rather than a gas process.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務觀點
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Perspective

blocks.zh: Device Constituent Sterilization：在 CDMO 的無菌充填環境中，氣體滅菌最常見的應用是對一次性元件（Single-Use Components）和預滅菌組件（Pre-sterilized Assemblies）的處理。這些元件由供應商以 EO 滅菌後交付，CDMO 需要驗證供應商的滅菌條件是否充分，並管理 EO 殘留風險。
blocks.en: Device Constituent Sterilization: In a CDMO's aseptic filling environment, the most common use of gaseous sterilization is for single-use components and pre-sterilized assemblies. These components are sterilized with EO by the supplier and then delivered, so the CDMO must verify that the supplier's sterilization conditions are adequate and manage the risk of EO residuals.

blocks.zh: Ethylene Oxide — 環氧乙烷
blocks.en: Ethylene Oxide

blocks.zh: EO 滅菌完整製程流程
blocks.en: Complete EO Sterilization Process Flow

blocks.zh: Prehumidification（預增濕） — 在滅菌腔外或腔內將物品暴露於高濕度環境，確保微生物含有足夠水分以對 EO 敏感
blocks.en: Prehumidification — exposing the items to a high-humidity environment, inside or outside the sterilizer chamber, so that the microorganisms contain enough moisture to be sensitive to EO

blocks.zh: Air Removal（抽真空排氣） — 移除腔內空氣，防止形成爆炸性混合氣體，並促進 EO 穿透
blocks.en: Air Removal (vacuum) — removing air from the chamber to prevent the formation of explosive mixtures and to promote EO penetration

blocks.zh: Rehumidification（再增濕） — 在腔內補充濕度，確保滅菌條件最佳化
blocks.en: Rehumidification — adding moisture inside the chamber to ensure optimal sterilization conditions

blocks.zh: Gas Exposure（氣體暴露） — 注入 EO，維持設定的濃度、溫度和時間
blocks.en: Gas Exposure — injecting EO and maintaining the set concentration, temperature and time

blocks.zh: Gas Removal（排氣） — 抽出 EO，進行多次真空/氮氣沖洗循環
blocks.en: Gas Removal — evacuating the EO, followed by multiple vacuum/nitrogen flush cycles

blocks.zh: Aeration（曝氣） — 長時間通風，讓殘留 EO 和副產物從材料中擴散出來
blocks.en: Aeration — prolonged ventilation to let residual EO and by-products diffuse out of the materials

blocks.zh: 重點提示 安全與環保
blocks.en: Key Point: Safety and Environment

blocks.zh: 爆炸風險：EO 在空氣中濃度超過 2.6%（v/v）即具爆炸性。實務上常用兩種策略降低風險：
blocks.en: Explosion risk: EO is explosive in air at concentrations above 2.6% (v/v). In practice, two strategies are commonly used to reduce the risk:

blocks.zh: 100% EO + 負壓操作 — 在負壓下操作，即使洩漏也不會達到爆炸濃度
blocks.en: 100% EO with negative-pressure operation — operating under negative pressure so that even a leak cannot reach an explosive concentration

blocks.zh: EO/惰性氣體混合物 — 使用 EO/CO2 或 EO/HCFC 混合物，將 EO 濃度稀釋到爆炸下限以下
blocks.en: EO/inert gas mixtures — using EO/CO2 or EO/HCFC mixtures to dilute the EO concentration below the lower explosive limit

blocks.zh: 環保法規趨勢：多國正收緊 EO 排放標準，推動產業尋找替代氣體或替代滅菌技術。
blocks.en: Environmental regulatory trend: Many countries are tightening EO emission standards, pushing the industry to look for alternative gases or alternative sterilization technologies.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 EO 殘留物控制
blocks.en: Key Point: Control of EO Residuals

blocks.zh: 三種殘留物及其毒性：
blocks.en: The three residuals and their toxicity:

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-7 規定了醫療器材上 EO 和 ECH 的最大允許殘留量。曝氣時間是控制殘留的關鍵 — 對厚壁高分子材料，曝氣可能需要數天甚至數週。
blocks.en: ISO 10993-7 specifies the maximum allowable residual levels of EO and ECH on medical devices. Aeration time is the key to controlling residuals — for thick-walled polymeric materials, aeration may take several days or even weeks.

blocks.zh: Ozone — 臭氧
blocks.en: Ozone

blocks.zh: 臭氧滅菌特性摘要
blocks.en: Summary of Ozone Sterilization Characteristics

blocks.zh: 殺菌機制：強氧化作用，破壞微生物細胞膜和 DNA
blocks.en: Killing mechanism: strong oxidation that destroys microbial cell membranes and DNA

blocks.zh: 優勢：現場生成（In Situ Generation），無需儲存危險化學品；殘留物為氧氣，環保友好；設備簡單，無消耗品
blocks.en: Advantages: generated in situ, so no hazardous chemicals need to be stored; the residual is oxygen, so it is environmentally friendly; simple equipment with no consumables

blocks.zh: 限制：穿透力不如 EO，不適合厚壁或多層包裝物品；在金屬和水分存在下快速降解，穩定性差
blocks.en: Limitations: penetration is weaker than EO, so it is unsuitable for thick-walled or multi-layer packaged items; it degrades quickly in the presence of metals and moisture, so stability is poor

blocks.zh: 最佳條件：室溫、RH >80%、濃度 2–10%
blocks.en: Optimal conditions: room temperature, RH >80%, concentration 2–10%

blocks.zh: BI：G. stearothermophilus 和 B. atrophaeus
blocks.en: BI: G. stearothermophilus and B. atrophaeus

blocks.zh: Chlorine Dioxide — 二氧化氯
blocks.en: Chlorine Dioxide

blocks.zh: 二氧化氯滅菌特性摘要
blocks.en: Summary of Chlorine Dioxide Sterilization Characteristics

blocks.zh: 非致癌性 — 這是相對於 EO 的重要安全優勢
blocks.en: Non-carcinogenic — an important safety advantage over EO

blocks.zh: 非易燃性 — 降低操作風險
blocks.en: Non-flammable — lowers operating risk

blocks.zh: 室溫有效 — 適用於熱敏感材料
blocks.en: Effective at room temperature — suitable for heat-sensitive materials

blocks.zh: 現場生成 — 因為純 ClO2 化學性質不穩定（Metastable）
blocks.en: Generated in situ — because pure ClO2 is chemically unstable (metastable)

blocks.zh: 穿透力有限 — 可能不如 EO 適合多層包裝
blocks.en: Limited penetration — may be less suitable than EO for multi-layer packaging

blocks.zh: Nitrogen Dioxide — 二氧化氮
blocks.en: Nitrogen Dioxide

blocks.zh: 二氧化氮滅菌特性摘要
blocks.en: Summary of Nitrogen Dioxide Sterilization Characteristics

blocks.zh: 室溫有效、非爆炸性
blocks.en: Effective at room temperature and non-explosive

blocks.zh: 殘留物安全性高 — 非致癌、非細胞毒性、非致畸性
blocks.en: Favorable residual safety profile — non-carcinogenic, non-cytotoxic and non-teratogenic

blocks.zh: 穿透力有限 — 但正因如此，曝氣（Aeration）時間更短
blocks.en: Limited penetration — but for that very reason, aeration time is shorter

blocks.zh: 材料相容性限制 — 與纖維素材料（紙、紙板）不相容，不適合以紙/紙板包裝的產品
blocks.en: Material compatibility limitation — incompatible with cellulosic materials (paper, cardboard), so not suitable for products packaged in paper or cardboard

blocks.zh: Validation of Gas Sterilization — 氣體滅菌驗證
blocks.en: Validation of Gas Sterilization

blocks.zh: 核心概念：半週期法 Half-Cycle Method
blocks.en: Core Concept: Half-Cycle Method

blocks.zh: 邏輯步驟：
blocks.en: Logical steps:

blocks.zh: Fractional Exposure Studies（分段暴露研究） — 以遞增的暴露時間測試 BI 存活率，找到「恰好完全殺滅 BI」的最短時間
blocks.en: Fractional Exposure Studies — testing BI survival at progressively longer exposure times to find the shortest time that "just completely kills" the BI

blocks.zh: Minimum Lethal Process Dwell Time（最短致死停留時間） — 上述「恰好完全殺滅」的時間
blocks.en: Minimum Lethal Process Dwell Time — the "just completely kills" time identified above

blocks.zh: Routine Dwell Time = 2 × Minimum（常規停留時間 = 2 倍最短致死時間） — 提供額外的安全裕度
blocks.en: Routine Dwell Time = 2 × Minimum — provides an additional safety margin

blocks.zh: 保守假設：由於缺乏氣體濃度/濕度/溫度對微生物影響的完整數據，半週期法假設製品的自然生物負載與 BI 具有相同的抗性和數量。這是一個非常保守的假設，但正因如此，半週期法被認為是最穩健的驗證方法。
blocks.en: Conservative assumption: Because complete data on the effects of gas concentration, humidity and temperature on microorganisms are lacking, the half-cycle method assumes that the product's natural bioburden has the same resistance and population as the BI. This is a very conservative assumption, but for that very reason the half-cycle method is regarded as the most robust validation approach.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Half-Cycle vs Bracketing
blocks.en: Analogy: Half-Cycle vs Bracketing

blocks.zh: 烤麵包的驗證：
blocks.en: Validating how to bake bread:

blocks.zh: 半週期法：你發現 180°C 烤 15 分鐘剛好把麵包烤熟。於是你規定每次都烤 30 分鐘（2倍）。簡單、安全，但可能烤過頭。
blocks.en: Half-cycle method: You find that baking at 180°C for 15 minutes just cooks the bread through, so you set the rule to always bake for 30 minutes (2×). It is simple and safe, but the bread may be overbaked.

blocks.zh: 包圍法：你測試了 170–190°C、12–20 分鐘的各種組合，找到「剛好熟」到「開始焦」的完整範圍。日常操作設定在中間值，既確保熟透又不會烤焦。更精細，但需要更多實驗。
blocks.en: Bracketing method: You test combinations from 170–190°C and 12–20 minutes and find the full range from "just cooked" to "starting to burn". Routine operation is set at the middle values, which ensures the bread is cooked through without burning. It is more refined, but needs more experiments.

blocks.zh: 進階概念：包圍法 Bracketing Method
blocks.en: Advanced Concept: Bracketing Method

blocks.zh: 比半週期法更精細的驗證策略：
blocks.en: A more refined validation strategy than the half-cycle method:

blocks.zh: 優勢：包圍法同時驗證了微生物殺滅效果（最小條件）和材料相容性（最大條件），建立了一個完整的操作窗口（Operating Window），而非僅依賴單一的「2倍安全係數」。
blocks.en: Advantages: The bracketing method verifies both microbial kill (minimum conditions) and material compatibility (maximum conditions), establishing a complete operating window rather than relying only on a single "2× safety factor".

blocks.zh: Equipment Qualification — 設備確效
blocks.en: Equipment Qualification

blocks.zh: 設備確效要點
blocks.en: Key Points of Equipment Qualification

blocks.zh: 氣體滅菌設備確效涵蓋標準的 IQ/OQ/PQ 三階段，但需特別關注：
blocks.en: Qualification of gaseous sterilization equipment covers the standard three IQ/OQ/PQ stages, but the following need particular attention:

blocks.zh: Pre-cycle Systems（前製程系統） — 真空泵浦、增濕系統、氣體供應與混合系統
blocks.en: Pre-cycle Systems — vacuum pumps, humidification system, gas supply and mixing systems

blocks.zh: Post-cycle Systems（後製程系統） — 排氣系統、廢氣處理（EO 分解器/焚燒爐）、曝氣設施
blocks.en: Post-cycle Systems — exhaust system, exhaust gas treatment (EO abator/incinerator), aeration facilities

blocks.zh: 安全連鎖（Safety Interlocks） — 門鎖、洩漏偵測、EO 濃度監測
blocks.en: Safety Interlocks — door locks, leak detection, EO concentration monitoring

blocks.zh: 控制系統 — 溫度、壓力、濕度感測器的校驗與警報設定
blocks.en: Control system — calibration of temperature, pressure and humidity sensors, and alarm settings

blocks.zh: Empty Chamber Parameter Distribution — 空腔參數分布
blocks.en: Empty Chamber Parameter Distribution

blocks.zh: 空腔分布測試要點
blocks.en: Key Points of Empty Chamber Distribution Testing

blocks.zh: 測試目的：確認氣體和濕度在空腔各處的均勻性，並建立常規監測點與腔內實際條件的相關性。
blocks.en: Purpose of the test: To confirm the uniformity of gas and humidity throughout the empty chamber, and to establish the correlation between the routine monitoring points and the actual conditions in the chamber.

blocks.zh: 關鍵發現：原文明確指出空腔均勻性測試不需要使用生物指示劑 — 這與蒸氣滅菌的空腔溫度分布測試邏輯一致。空腔測試僅需物理/化學量測（溫度、濕度、氣體濃度分布），BI 留到負載測試階段使用。
blocks.en: Key finding: The source text explicitly states that empty chamber uniformity testing does not need biological indicators — consistent with the logic of empty chamber temperature distribution testing in steam sterilization. Empty chamber testing needs only physical/chemical measurements (temperature, humidity, gas concentration distribution); BIs are reserved for the load testing stage.

blocks.zh: Component & Load Mapping — 組件與負載佈局
blocks.en: Component & Load Mapping

blocks.zh: 重點提示 氣體滅菌 vs 蒸氣/乾熱滅菌的佈局差異
blocks.en: Key Point: Mapping Differences Between Gas Sterilization and Steam/Dry Heat Sterilization

blocks.zh: 為什麼不能使用侵入式取樣？在蒸氣或乾熱滅菌中，可以在負載中插入溫度探針（Thermocouple）來測量熱穿透。但在氣體滅菌中，插入任何取樣裝置都會破壞負載的原始結構，改變氣體和濕度的穿透路徑，導致測量結果不代表實際條件。
blocks.en: Why can invasive sampling not be used? In steam or dry heat sterilization, temperature probes (thermocouples) can be inserted into the load to measure heat penetration. In gas sterilization, however, inserting any sampling device disrupts the original structure of the load and alters the penetration paths of gas and humidity, so the measurements would not represent the actual conditions.

blocks.zh: 替代方案：使用 BI 或 PCD（Process Challenge Device）放置在最難穿透的位置（Worst-Case Locations），這些位置通常是：
blocks.en: Alternative: Place BIs or PCDs (Process Challenge Devices) at the locations hardest to penetrate (worst-case locations), which are typically:

blocks.zh: 多層包裝的最內層
blocks.en: The innermost layer of multi-layer packaging

blocks.zh: 負載中心（氣體最後到達的區域）
blocks.en: The center of the load (the area the gas reaches last)

blocks.zh: 厚壁高分子部件的內部
blocks.en: The interior of thick-walled polymeric parts

blocks.zh: 負載密度最高的區域
blocks.en: The areas of highest load density

blocks.zh: Biological Indicators — 生物指示劑
blocks.en: Biological Indicators

blocks.zh: BI 選擇與放置準則
blocks.en: Criteria for BI Selection and Placement

blocks.zh: 放置原則：BI 必須放在具代表性的最差位置，但不能阻塞氣體通道或干擾滅菌劑在物品內部的分布/穿透。這是一個微妙的平衡 — 放在最難到達的位置，但不能因為放置 BI 而改變該位置的穿透條件。
blocks.en: Placement principle: BIs must be placed at representative worst-case locations, but must not block gas pathways or interfere with the distribution/penetration of the sterilant inside the item. This is a delicate balance — place the BI at the hardest-to-reach location, but without altering the penetration conditions at that location by placing it there.

blocks.zh: Process Confirmation & Microbiological Challenge — 製程確認與微生物挑戰
blocks.en: Process Confirmation & Microbiological Challenge

blocks.zh: 製程確認的核心邏輯
blocks.en: Core Logic of Process Confirmation

blocks.zh: 雙重證據原則：
blocks.en: Principle of dual evidence:

blocks.zh: 物理/化學量測 — 腔內感測器確認溫度、壓力、濕度、氣體濃度達到設定值
blocks.en: Physical/chemical measurements — in-chamber sensors confirm that temperature, pressure, humidity and gas concentration reach the set values

blocks.zh: 微生物挑戰 — BI 全部被殺滅，證明致死條件確實在負載最差位置實現
blocks.en: Microbiological challenge — all BIs are killed, demonstrating that lethal conditions are actually achieved at the worst-case locations in the load

blocks.zh: Replicate Studies（重複研究）：驗證不是做一次就夠 — 必須以重複批次（通常至少 3 批）證明製程的一致性和可重複性。每一批次都必須同時滿足物理量測和 BI 殺滅兩個條件。
blocks.en: Replicate Studies: Validation is not complete after a single run — consistency and reproducibility of the process must be demonstrated with replicate batches (usually at least 3). Every batch must meet both the physical measurement and BI kill criteria.

blocks.zh: Routine Process Control — 常規製程控制
blocks.en: Routine Process Control

blocks.zh: 七大常規控制實務
blocks.en: Seven Routine Control Practices

blocks.zh: Calibration（校驗） — 溫度、壓力、濕度感測器的定期校驗
blocks.en: Calibration — periodic calibration of temperature, pressure and humidity sensors

blocks.zh: Physical Measurements（物理量測） — 每批次紀錄關鍵參數
blocks.en: Physical Measurements — recording critical parameters for every batch

blocks.zh: Ongoing Process Control（持續製程控制） — 趨勢分析，偵測製程偏移
blocks.en: Ongoing Process Control — trend analysis to detect process drift

blocks.zh: Change Control（變更控制） — 任何製程、設備、材料變更都需評估對驗證狀態的影響
blocks.en: Change Control — any change to the process, equipment or materials must be assessed for its impact on the validated state

blocks.zh: Preventive Maintenance（預防保養） — 按計畫執行設備保養
blocks.en: Preventive Maintenance — carrying out equipment maintenance as scheduled

blocks.zh: Periodic Reassessment（定期再評估） — 週期性重新確認驗證狀態
blocks.en: Periodic Reassessment — periodically reconfirming the validated state

blocks.zh: Training（教育訓練） — 操作人員的持續培訓
blocks.en: Training — ongoing training of operating personnel

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Parametric Release vs BI Release
blocks.en: Key Point: Parametric Release vs BI Release

blocks.zh: 兩種放行模式：
blocks.en: Two release modes:

blocks.zh: Parametric Release（參數放行） — 僅依據物理/化學參數放行，不需要等待 BI 培養結果。前提是已經建立了充分的參數與滅菌效果的相關性（見 ⟨1222⟩）
blocks.en: Parametric Release — release based only on physical/chemical parameters, without waiting for BI culture results. This requires that a sufficient correlation between the parameters and sterilization efficacy has already been established (see ⟨1222⟩)

blocks.zh: BI Release（BI 放行） — 每批滅菌負載都放置 BI，必須等到 BI 培養結果確認為陰性（通常 7 天）才能放行。這是大多數 EO 滅菌操作的現行做法
blocks.en: BI Release — a BI is placed in every sterilized load, and the load can be released only after the BI culture is confirmed negative (usually 7 days). This is the current practice for most EO sterilization operations

blocks.zh: CDMO 影響：如果使用 BI 放行，滅菌後需要 7 天的等待期才能放行使用，這會顯著影響生產排程和庫存管理。
blocks.en: CDMO impact: With BI release, a 7-day waiting period after sterilization is needed before the items can be released for use, which significantly affects production scheduling and inventory management.

blocks.zh: References — 參考文獻
blocks.en: References

blocks.zh: 延伸閱讀建議
blocks.en: Suggested Further Reading

blocks.zh: ISO 11135（Ref 2, 3） — EO 滅菌的國際標準，是醫療器材 EO 滅菌驗證的主要依據。2007/2008 版後已整合為 ISO 11135:2014
blocks.en: ISO 11135 (Ref 2, 3) — the international standard for EO sterilization and the main basis for EO sterilization validation of medical devices. The 2007/2008 editions have since been consolidated into ISO 11135:2014

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-7（Ref 4） — 規定了 EO、ECH、EG 的最大允許殘留量，是 CDMO 接收供應商 EO 滅菌元件時的驗收依據
blocks.en: ISO 10993-7 (Ref 4) — specifies the maximum allowable residual levels of EO, ECH and EG, and is the acceptance basis when a CDMO receives EO-sterilized components from suppliers

blocks.zh: USP ⟨1229⟩ 系列 — 本章是 ⟨1229⟩ 系列的一部分，與 ⟨1229.1⟩ 蒸氣、⟨1229.8⟩ 乾熱、⟨1229.10⟩ 輻照、⟨1229.11⟩ 蒸氣相等章節互為補充
blocks.en: USP ⟨1229⟩ series — this chapter is part of the ⟨1229⟩ series and complements ⟨1229.1⟩ (steam), ⟨1229.8⟩ (dry heat), ⟨1229.10⟩ (radiation) and ⟨1229.11⟩ (vapor)

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 氣體滅菌的定位：適用於不耐熱、不耐輻照的物品（尤其是高分子醫療器材），以化學反應殺死微生物
blocks.en: Positioning of gaseous sterilization: Suitable for items that cannot tolerate heat or irradiation (especially polymeric medical devices), killing microorganisms by chemical reaction

blocks.zh: EO 是主流：穿透力最強，可用於最終包裝滅菌，但有致癌性、爆炸性，且殘留物需嚴格控制
blocks.en: EO is the mainstream agent: It has the strongest penetration and can be used for sterilization in final packaging, but it is carcinogenic and explosive, and its residuals must be strictly controlled

blocks.zh: 替代氣體（O3、ClO2、NO2）：安全性較高但穿透力有限，各有材料相容性限制
blocks.en: Alternative gases (O3, ClO2, NO2): Safer but with limited penetration, and each has material compatibility limitations

blocks.zh: 驗證核心：半週期法（保守穩健）或包圍法（精細但需更多數據），均以 BI 殺滅 + 物理量測雙重證據為基礎
blocks.en: Core of validation: The half-cycle method (conservative and robust) or the bracketing method (more refined but needing more data), both based on dual evidence of BI kill plus physical measurements

blocks.zh: 負載佈局特殊性：不能使用侵入式取樣，僅能透過 BI/PCD 放置於最差位置來評估
blocks.en: Special nature of load mapping: Invasive sampling cannot be used; assessment relies only on placing BIs/PCDs at worst-case locations

blocks.zh: 常規控制七要素：校驗、物理量測、持續製程控制、變更控制、預防保養、定期再評估、教育訓練
blocks.en: Seven elements of routine control: calibration, physical measurements, ongoing process control, change control, preventive maintenance, periodic reassessment and training

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務影響：供應商交付的 EO 滅菌元件需要驗證殘留物合規（ISO 10993-7），BI 放行的 7 天等待期影響生產排程
blocks.en: CDMO practical impact: EO-sterilized components delivered by suppliers require verification of residual compliance (ISO 10993-7), and the 7-day wait for BI release affects production scheduling
